description: Pipeline to return custom error response with status code at any stage

stages.script: function handleRequest() { return { request: {...context.request, body: JSON.stringify({ query: [{ id: 'search', value: 'harry', dataField: 'original_title'}] })}}}

stages.description: To extract the query key from request body
stages.script: function handleRequest() { try { return { query: JSON.parse(context.request.body).query[0].value }} catch(e) { throw e }}

stages.description: To get data from data muse api in asynchronous manner
Fetch RS API response from Appbase and write to response
Merges the data muse response to RS API response
stages.script: function handleRequest() { return { response: {...context.response, body: JSON.stringify({...JSON.parse(context.response.body), data_muse: context.data_muse_api })}}}
